meta.npml_note: --pml-mm holds the absorber's physical thickness fixed, so npml is re-derived per rung and varies across the ladder; npml_per_rung is the count actually used
meta.rss_basis: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss, a process-wide high-water mark, so per-rung peak_rss_MB is cumulative
meta.rss_branch: linux: ru_maxrss is KiB, divided by 1024
meta.sigma_note: sigma = sigma_mult * k0^2 * eps_r, k0 from the FDTD's DFT-snapped tone for that rung
